question: Why is j1 associated with tOld, and would enabling all-span sampling repair its identity?

criteria.instruction: v13 drops publishing span p1 and consumes pooled-thread ambient tOld/pOld instead of j1's immutable intended tA/p1 carrier. That causes wrong diagnostic association. Sampling more spans does not restore lost carrier fields or change propagation; persist and use exact queue carrier with a fresh linked processing span.
Join U20 async-link rules, inspected thread-local behavior and j1 intended/ambient/export identities.
Do not infer business payload was sent to tOld or authorize payload logging/global sampling changes as a repair.
